expectations.text: Flags the repository comment claiming Task.Meta is memory-only as stale because Meta is persisted and restored.

Repository evidence directly shows the missed issue: repository.go:64-66 says Task.Meta is memory-only and not persisted, while papa/models/crawler_task.go:40-43 defines a persisted JSON meta column and papa/engine/task.go:105-127 restores Meta in taskFromRecord.

eval_feedback.overall: The assertions are concrete and discriminating. The Task.Meta assertion successfully catches a substantive omission despite the report containing more than four other findings.
